CHAPTER 2 · ITEM 07 / 12

Production possibilities frontier (PPF)

PPF shapePPF 形狀

YOUR CHECKBOX · 原始清單項目

Explain a straight-line PPF with constant opportunity cost and a bowed-out PPF with increasing opportunity cost due to resources differing in suitability.

01 · UNDERSTAND / 概念解釋

直線 PPF 代表固定機會成本；向外彎曲的 PPF 隨 X 增加而變陡，因資源專長不同，後來轉入 X 的資源代價較高。

A straight PPF has constant opportunity cost. A bowed-out PPF becomes steeper as more X is produced because resources transferred into X become less suitable for it relative to Y.

02 · WORKED EXAMPLE / 一個示範

See it in action.

Example 例：A specialist farmer switches first to farming; moving a skilled engineer into farming later may sacrifice much more engineering output. 依專長順序轉移資源，邊際代價會增加。

03 · TRY IT / 例題練習

One question. Your turn.

A bowed-out PPF normally implies what as X production expands? X 生產增加時通常怎樣？
